subject: clownfish
title: Every Clownfish Is Born Male. One Of Them Doesn't Stay That Way

scenes.text: Nemo's whole family has a secret. Every clownfish is born male.
Each anemone has a strict group: one female, one breeding male, and a few smaller males below.
The female is always the biggest and the boss. If she dies, everything changes.
The top male grows, and his body turns female. Every other fish moves up one rank.
So in a clownfish family, the dad becomes the mom.
